senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) design, art.—מלאכת מ׳ a productive work (with a direct purpose).
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 13b:13">Bets. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chagigah 10b:1">Ḥag. 10ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מלאכת מ׳ אסרה תורה</he> the Torah forbids (on the Sabbath) productive work (by which you affect the property of an object, not mere changing of position, planless efforts &c.).
